name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.210.0 — Behaviour-lane review follow-ups (q294): the CAPTURE gate refuses a --diff that reports a diff but prints no readable result instead of counting the pair as zero; the look stop prints its reply and Then block once with one accept command per diffing pair; the review driver warns with the manual git branch -D remedy when harden/<stem> cannot be deleted; stage-build says the session, not the driver, boots the app. 7.209.0 — The build driver gains the behaviour lane: a lane: behaviour spec is refused while its brief's proto/ branch still exists, otherwise opens with HARDEN_MERGE (the session merges harden/<stem>, the mark verifies ancestry) and, after a green gate, CAPTURE (proto-capture.js runs every contract route x state against the freeze and diffs it; a diff is accepted at a look stop by the literal accept <route> <state> or fixed and re-captured), with capture: { pairs, diffs, accepted } recorded on the build row; the review driver deletes harden/<stem> after a behaviour-lane merge-back; the reviewer's ground-yourself-first list now reads the host's design.rules file. 7.208.0 — /spec:prototype can now freeze: on approve, --mark frozen refuses unless the kit gates are green on the prototype tree and a capture exists per declared route and state, then writes structural captures keyed by kit-composite instance (new proto-capture.js, with a --diff comparison) and contract.json, and reserves the behaviour-lane spec and its AC ids; the TESTS step prints one line per behaviour pin, and --mark tests-derived requires every reserved id in the host e2e file and in the host runner's listing, then exports the data/API layer to harden/<stem> via git diff | git apply, writes the brief's Data/API sub-plan and a lint-clean hardened spec, runs dbDestroy, deletes the prototype worktree and branch, and appends one stage: prototype ledger row.
